suggested_experiment_name: ISL/fifth-force composite (Stanford, Lamoreaux, Colorado, Irvine, Eot-Wash)
coupling_convention: |alpha|, dimensionless Yukawa strength relative to gravity (as plotted)
notes: This is a review article (Adelberger, Heckel & Nelson, Annu. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 2003) on tests of the gravitational inverse-square law, i.e. Yukawa fifth-force / ScalarNucleon-type constraints. Results are presented in the alpha-lambda plane (Figures 4, 5, 9) as 95%-CL exclusion curves, not as a coupling-vs-mass table, and no numerical data points are given in the text. It compiles existing experimental limits rather than presenting a single new measurement. Only qualitative statements exist (e.g. alpha>=16/3 excluded for lambda>130 um; R*<155 um for alpha=8/3).
